title: Toward Agentic AI for the 6G Physical Layer: From Algorithm Discovery to Verified Baseband Silicon
abstract: arXiv:2610.27797v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: 6G will be designed faster than it can be built: AI-driven search already proposes physical-layer algorithms at machine speed, while carrying a single one onto embedded baseband silicon remains specialist work. That silicon imposes hard memory and numeric limits, but also exposes cost structures a GPU lacks, and a design flow that never runs on the target sees neither. We present an agentic workflow in which an LLM coding agent implements algorithms on a commercial baseband SoC, optimizes them down to agent-written vector assembly, and validates them on silicon. The agent is guided by a knowledge base of measured platform facts, checked at every step against evaluators it is instructed never to edit, and metered per phase. We showcase the workflow on an AI-discovered orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) detector portfolio on the open 6G4All platform. translated_title: 迈向面向6G物理层的智能体AI：从算法发现到经验证的基带硅片
translated_abstract: 6G的设计速度将快于其构建速度：AI驱动的搜索已经能够以机器速度提出物理层算法，而将其中任何一个算法移植到嵌入式基带硅片上仍然是专家级的工作。这些硅片带来了严格的内存和数值限制，但也暴露了GPU所不具备的成本结构，而从未在目标硬件上运行的设计流程对这两者都无法感知。我们提出了一种智能体工作流程，其中一个LLM编码智能体在商用基带SoC上实现算法，将其优化至智能体自行编写的向量汇编级别，并在硅片上进行验证。该智能体由一个包含实测平台事实的知识库引导，在每一步都受到被指示永不修改的评估器的检查，并按阶段进行计量。我们在开放的6G4All平台上，通过AI发现的正交时频空间（OTFS）检测器组合展示了该工作流程。它产出了十二个在硅片上精确到周期运行的内核，其优化版本……
tldr: 提出了一种由LLM编码智能体驱动的6G物理层设计工作流程，该智能体能够在商用基带SoC上实现AI发现的算法、将其优化至向量汇编级别并在硅片上验证，最终产出十二个周期精确运行的内核。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an agentic AI workflow in which an LLM coding agent implements, optimizes down to vector assembly, and validates AI-discovered 6G physical-layer algorithms on commercial baseband silicon, yielding twelve cycle-exact kernels.
